title: NDA-SAD reunion: Why the Akali Dal severed ties with BJP 6 years ago

ai.summary: The BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) reunited after severing ties over farm laws in 2020, with Prime Minister Modi calling it a step for Punjab's welfare. The SAD had left the NDA in 2020 amid protests against agricultural laws, which were later repealed in 2021.

facts.claim: the BJP and its oldest ally, the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD), have reunited ahead of the Punjab Assembly elections in 2027
facts.quote: Six years after parting ways over differences on the three farm laws, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and its oldest ally, the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD), have reunited ahead of the Punjab Assembly elections in 2027.

facts.claim: the SAD and the BJP had been allies since the late 1990s
facts.quote: The SAD and the BJP had been allies since the late 1990s.

facts.claim: the SAD severed ties with the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) in 2020
facts.quote: However, amid widespread protests against the Centre’s farm laws, the SAD severed ties with the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) in 2020.

facts.claim: Prime Minister Narendra Modi described the development as an effort to place Punjab and the welfare of its people above all else
facts.quote: Prime Minister Narendra Modi described the development as an effort to place Punjab and the welfare of its people above all else.

facts.claim: the SAD exited the NDA in 2020, with party MP Harsimrat Kaur Badal also resigning from the Union Council of Ministers in protest against the legislation
facts.quote: The SAD exited the NDA in 2020, with party MP Harsimrat Kaur Badal also resigning from the Union Council of Ministers in protest against the legislation, which sought to overhaul agricultural marketing and triggered months-long demonstrations at Delhi’s borders.

facts.claim: the Farm Laws Repeal Bill was passed by both the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha without discussion on the opening day of the Winter Session in December 2021
facts.quote: Amid protests from Opposition parties and farmers, particularly in Punjab, both the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha passed the Farm Laws Repeal Bill without discussion on the opening day of the Winter Session in December 2021.

facts.claim: the three farm laws were repealed in 2021
facts.quote: Subsequently, the Law Ministry notified the Farm Laws Repeal Act, 2021, nullifying the three farm laws enacted by Parliament in 2020.

ai.background_note: The SAD and BJP reunited after a 2020 split over farm laws, which were repealed in 2021. The alliance is ahead of 2027 Punjab Assembly elections.
